ios.title: Silence every notification on iPhone
ios.intro: A web app can't turn on Do Not Disturb by itself, but your iPhone can do it for you whenever ONMi opens. Set it up once:
steps: Open Settings → Focus and tap the + button, then choose Custom and name it "ONMi".
Under Allowed Notifications, leave People and Apps empty so nothing gets through.
Tap Set Schedule or Automation → Add Schedule → App, and choose ONMi.
Open ONMi: the Focus turns on by itself and turns off when you leave the app.
ios.note: Steps may vary slightly between iOS versions. This is an iPhone setting, ONMi can't check that it is on.
